drumragh parish 18 october 2026 2st paul could have written this passage from today’s second reading to our seminarians and to the men discerning their vocation: “we know, brothers, that god loves you and that you have been chosen, because when we brought the good news to you, it came to you not only as words, but as power and the holy spirit and as utter conviction.” catholic mothers ireland — pray & play starting tuesday 27 october at 11.00am in drumragh pastoral centre, omagh. take a well-deserved break to connect with fellow mums for uplifting prayer, heartfelt conversation and fun moments together. all ages and stages are welcome. for more information, contact sinéad on 07523 104760. omagh charismatic prayer group — day of prayer and healing speaker: fr john keane. theme: ‘people of god’s delight’. saturday 15 november, silverbirch hotel, bt79 7dh. registration 9.30am; holy mass and healing service in the afternoon. £40 includes coffee and lunch. booking by sunday 1 november is essential for catering. please include dietary requirements. contact evelyn on 07876 411435 or kathleen on 07596 609041. temporary mass schedule change — christ the king, strathroy due to roadworks on the gortin and strathroy roads, the vigil mass will move temporarily from christ the king church to st mary’s church, killyclogher, at 6.30pm on saturdays 24 and 31 october.

st joseph’s hall, tuesday 20 october at 8.30pm. eucharistic ministers — refresher training eucharistic ministers in cappagh and drumragh parishes are invited to a refresher training session in christ the king church on tuesday 20 october at 8.00pm or in sacred heart church on wednesday 21 october at 8.00pm. choose whichever evening suits you. ministers serving churches, homes, hospitals and care homes are all welcome. clerical changes 2026 bishop michael router has announced clerical changes for the diocese of derry. fr stephen baxter, currently curate in cappagh and drumragh, will become curate in glendermott and strathfoyle. although his time with us was short, we thank stephen for his support and guidance. we send him our prayers and blessings as he moves to his new mission. derry diocesan young adult community those aged 18–35 are invited to join the new community every tuesday evening at 7.30pm, starting 20 october, at claudy pastoral centre. the programme includes speakers, scripture, prayer, food and fellowship, plus organised social events. email
yvonne.rooney@derrydiocese.org

. world mission sunday — one in christ, united in mission world mission sunday is the holy father’s annual worldwide celebration of prayer, solidarity and support for the church’s missionary life. it invites catholics everywhere to participate in the church’s global mission through prayer and financial support for mission dioceses most in need. every baptised person shares responsibility for proclaiming the gospel and supporting the growth of the church throughout the world. the theme for world mission sunday is chosen by the holy father. pope leo xiv served as a missionary priest and bishop in peru, where he sawhow faith, prayer and generosity can transform communities. our mission — prayer send me, lord, out into the world that begins at my front door. may my every word flow from your heart and my actions be of love and peace, that everything i do or say reflects your great mercy to all. help me witness to your truth no less in my silence than in my words and show me, lord, the way i should go. help me to see that my solemn duty to spread your gospel to everyone in the world is second only to their right to hear and respond to it. open my eyes to your
